name: Ring of Cleared Mind
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like and functions as a ring of clear thought, but the wearer must make a DC 15 concentration check for any spell they cast.

This ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of clear thought

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
